query:
SELECT 
    externalId,
    title,
    district,
    CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2)) as price_num,
    currency,
    bedrooms,
    CAST(area AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as area_num,
    ownerWhatsapp,
    sourceUrl
FROM properties
WHERE 
    district LIKE '%Surco%'
    AND propertyType = 'departamento'
    AND bedrooms BETWEEN 1 AND 4
    AND CAST(area AS DECIMAL(10,2)) BETWEEN 50 AND 100
    AND currency = 'USD'
    AND CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2)) BETWEEN 80000 AND 120000
    AND isActive = 1
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
